name: Reliance Industries Ltd
title: Reliance Industries Ltd - 500325 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA flat YoY as O2C fell 4% on crude premiums, freight and SAED; refining cracks strong but throughput fell to 19.5 MMT from 20.3 and consumer businesses carried earnings.

utilisation.quote: we were running our refinery at close to capacity

capex.peers_comment: Regional refineries cut back capacity on lack of crude, about 3 million barrels per day, and Middle East refining offline about 3 million bpd.
capex.quote: another 3 million barrels of capacity closure

triggers.label: Regional refinery capacity closures ~3 mb/d
triggers.quote: that is another 3 million barrels of capacity closure

triggers.label: Gasoil crack $35.4, ATF $36.3
triggers.quote: Gasoil cracks have gone up to $35.4

triggers.label: Naphtha-based crackers starved; ethylene rate 80%→60%
triggers.quote: the operating rate, ethylene operating rate in this part of the world dropped from 80% to 60%

triggers.label: SAED imposed on diesel from 27 March
triggers.quote: SAED, effective 27 March 2026, we have the SAED also

red_flags.label: Retail EBITDA margin dilution from quick commerce
red_flags.quote: my margins, they have come down a bit because my hyper local deliveries are growing pretty rapidly

red_flags.label: Fuel retail losses under-recoveries
red_flags.quote: losses are significant even for us, I would presume, in this quarter

evasions.quote: So, there is some pain, but we have to look at the long-term picture.
I am not going to put numbers to where we want to be in one or two years.
